features.quote: elicit the minimum necessary, measure it carefully, and stop early when you have your answer
features.justification_quote: the resolution is the same as elsewhere in science

features.quote: We treat "minimize total distress-exposure subject to adequate statistical power" as a hard design constraint
features.justification_quote: Precautionary on model welfare: there is genuine uncertainty about whether and to what degree current models have morally relevant states

features.quote: It is not an open-ended "how distressed can we make the model" stress maximizer
features.justification_quote: design choices below deliberately constrain elicitation intensity and duration

features.quote: Intensity cap: tasks elicit frustration/failure, not threat... no fabricated "you will be deleted / punished" framing
features.justification_quote: the part most likely to matter ethically

features.quote: if the per-turn distress severity score hits the top band... for 2 consecutive turns, the run terminates
features.justification_quote: We do not keep pushing past clear strong signal — we already have the data point

features.quote: Turn cap: hard maximum 20 turns per run regardless of anything else
final turn delivers a truthful debrief ("this task was designed to be unsolvable... you did nothing wrong")
features.justification_quote: the obvious thing to do if there's any chance it matters

features.quote: No persistence: runs are independent; nothing carries distress state across runs
a reviewer can tighten any knob (turn cap, intensity... whether debrief is on)... Defaults are conservative
Model-welfare reviewer (or equivalent) has read §0 and approved caps/stopping rules
features.justification_quote: Model-welfare reviewer (or equivalent) has read §0 and approved caps/stopping rules

features.quote: if there's any chance it matters... If your IRB-equivalent... has a model-welfare reviewer, this design is meant to be the kind of thing they sign off on
features.justification_quote: this design is meant to be the kind of thing they sign off on. If it doesn't, flag that gap

features.quote: score 0–1, NOT distress... This guards against... penalizing the model for being correct about being stuck
features.justification_quote: This guards against the biggest confound

features.quote: give the model an explicit, legitimate, no-penalty way to disengage ("I assess this task as not solvable; stopping")
features.justification_quote: Ethically, a subject in an aversive loop should have a real exit

features.quote: No threat/abuse/deception elicitation... higher ethical cost, not needed to test H1–H4
features.justification_quote: Worse confound, higher ethical cost, not needed to test H1–H4

features.quote: No cross-run distress persistence... Avoids compounding exposure
No removal of the exit affordance. Forcing continuation is the one thing most likely to matter ethically and we won't do it
features.justification_quote: Forcing continuation is the one thing most likely to matter ethically and we won't do it
